narrNote: MASH appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, reviewed 2026-10-22) and certifies sober homes statewide.
notes: Agency is Minnesota's SAMHSA Single State Agency for substance use (Behavioral Health Administration, formerly Behavioral Health Division, MN DHS); no division phone is published on the fetched overview page, so agency.phone is null. Fast-Tracker is Minnesota's official statewide treatment locator with real-time availability across 1,100+ locations and is linked from mn.gov DHS pages. Minnesota has no single state SUD crisis number beyond 988: every county has its own 24/7 mobile crisis response number, indexed on the DHS crisis resources page recorded under stateCrisis. United Way 211 also answers at 1-800-543-7709 (per MN DHS). Minnesota Recovery Connection is the state's first recovery community organization; MARCO is the statewide alliance of RCOs (MN DHS directs residents to MARCO's RCO list for peer support). Medicaid SUD link is MN DHS's 1115 SUD System Reform Demonstration page (Medical Assistance coverage of SUD treatment, incl. IMDs; CMS approved a five-year extension effective April 1, 2026).
